pr.title: feat: auto skip consent screen for trusted oauth clients
pr.body:
## What does this PR do?

Allow trusted clients to skip the consent screens. Only first-party apps (us) will be set up as trusted clients.
pr.head: feat/auto-constent-trusted-clints
